She is arriving from Luko, where she was VP of Finance, member of the Executive Committee and built support functions (finance, legal, compliance, and risk). She also drove the execution of strategic topics from fundraising to M&A, as well as international expansion. Margaux started her career at Société Générale in the General Inspection department, leading assignments across business lines and countries from retail strategy in the Czech Republic to CIB compliance in NY. Margaux graduated from HEC, Dauphine, and Sciences Po. Stella Walter takes over as Head of Talent. Prior to joining Alven Stella helped scale Luko, where she grew the team from 30 to 250, hired the C-Suite, defined Culture & HR processes, and merged teams following M&A operations. She was VP of People and a member of the executive committee. Her previous experiences include managing roles at the likes of Eutopia VC, Showroomprivé and L'Oréal.
